items.heading: Poi (Solomon Style)
details: Key ingredients: taro, coconut cream, banana
Boil taro root until soft.
Mash the taro with a little water into a smooth paste.
Fold in coconut cream and mashed banana for sweetness.
Serve as a filling side dish.

items.heading: Motu (Fish and Coconut Bundle)
details: Key ingredients: fish, coconut cream, banana leaf
Season fish fillets and wrap them in banana leaves with coconut cream.
Tie the parcels securely.
Steam or bake until the fish is cooked through.
Unwrap and serve with rice or taro.
